series.title: 在线索引变更：并发构建仍有等待与成本
series.premise: 订单检索按租户和日期筛选，申请在十月分区叶表创建非唯一复合索引。隔离副本预演后，只批准这一分区作为首批生产变更。
series.outcome: 低峰用CREATE INDEX CONCURRENTLY执行叶表索引构建，观察短时锁等待、资源与复制延迟。构建完成且有效，查询和写入验收通过。保留查询开关回退，失败残留及后续独立删除流程评审清楚；其他分区不自动扩展。

accentTarget.basis: spoken audio duration excluding silence and narration

phraseDefinitions.zh: 预写日志生成量或速率
索引是否处于有效状态

recycling.note: 未来候选回访不计实际出现；旧引用仅为p001-p350及本文件前段表达。

dialogues.title: 限定一个叶分区
dialogues.premise: 订单检索申请增加索引，先确认数据库版本和变更范围。
dialogues.listeningTask: 听出并发构建不是跨数据库通用的无锁承诺。

lines.en: We need a concurrent index build. October order searches miss their latency target.
lines.zh: 需要并发建索引，十月订单检索达不到延迟目标。

lines.en: Which database and exact table scope? Online doesn't mean identical behavior everywhere.
lines.zh: 哪个数据库，具体表范围是什么？在线操作不代表各数据库行为相同。

lines.en: PostgreSQL sixteen, October leaf partition only. This isn't a parent-wide index build.
lines.zh: PostgreSQL 16，只做十月叶分区，不是给整个父表建索引。

lines.en: Just to confirm, one partition first, right? All other partitions stay outside approval.
lines.zh: 确认一下，先一个分区，对吧？其他分区不在批准范围。

lines.en: Agreed. Dry-run it first on isolation. Use production-like data without customer access.
lines.zh: 同意，先在隔离环境预演，使用类似生产的数据但不给客户访问。

lines.en: I've got bandwidth for query testing. Maybe the filter needs adjustment too.
lines.zh: 我有精力测试查询，也许筛选条件也需调整。

lines.en: Then show the expected access pattern. Don't approve an index from symptoms.
lines.zh: 那展示预期访问模式，不能只凭症状批准索引。

lines.en: Okay, broader indexing? Let's park that. One action item is measured benefit.
lines.zh: 好，更大范围建索引先放一边，一个行动项是测量收益。

lines.en: Include insert costs in the rehearsal. Read speed isn't our only concern.
lines.zh: 预演也包含插入成本，读速度不是唯一关注点。

lines.en: So, I'll attach the exact statement. Non-unique tenant and date columns, nothing else.
lines.zh: 那我附上准确语句，非唯一的租户和日期列，不改其他内容。

dialogues.title: 收益要匹配真实查询
dialogues.premise: 范围限定十月叶分区，隔离预演比较索引前后执行计划。
dialogues.listeningTask: 区分小租户收益、宽范围扫描和写入代价。

lines.en: The query plan uses the candidate index. Small tenant searches read fewer pages.
lines.zh: 执行计划使用候选索引，小租户查询读取更少数据页。

lines.en: What about large tenants and wide dates? The planner may choose scans there.
lines.zh: 大租户和宽日期范围呢？优化器在那种情况下可能选择扫描。

lines.en: It does for very broad searches. That's reasonable, not automatically a regression.
lines.zh: 宽范围查询确实会扫描，这是合理选择，不自动算回归。

lines.en: Just to confirm, production-like skew, right? Uniform test rows could flatter results.
lines.zh: 确认一下，数据偏斜类似生产，对吧？均匀测试行可能美化结果。

lines.en: Yes, and inserts ran beside reads. Extra index maintenance increased their latency slightly.
lines.zh: 是，插入和读取同时运行，额外索引维护让插入延迟略升。

lines.en: Our working hypothesis passed sampled queries. Maybe peak concurrency changes that balance.
lines.zh: 当前假设通过抽样查询验证，但峰值并发可能改变收益平衡。

lines.en: The smoke test includes empty results. Also test tenant isolation and pagination.
lines.zh: 冒烟测试包含空结果，也测试租户隔离和分页。

lines.en: So, what's the ETA for load tests? We need them before scheduling production.
lines.zh: 那负载测试预计多久？排生产窗口前必须完成。

lines.en: This afternoon, using the approved workload. No heavy explain analysis against production.
lines.zh: 今天下午，使用批准负载，不在线上做重型执行分析。

lines.en: Okay, concurrent index build remains the proposal. Next we review its locking boundaries.
lines.zh: 好，并发建索引仍是提案，下一步评审锁边界。

dialogues.title: 并发不等于完全无锁
dialogues.premise: 查询收益有证据，讨论PostgreSQL并发构建与其他数据库DDL差异。
dialogues.listeningTask: 听清事务等待、短时锁和不能类推的数据库行为。

lines.en: A concurrent index build still takes locks. It can wait for older transactions.
lines.zh: 并发建索引仍会获取锁，也可能等待较早开始的事务。

lines.en: So a lock wait remains possible. Ordinary writes can continue through most phases.
lines.zh: 所以仍可能等锁，大多数阶段普通写入可以继续。

lines.en: I said lock-free earlier, that's wrong. I meant reduced blocking for this engine.
lines.zh: 我之前说无锁，那不对，我指这个数据库能减少阻塞。

lines.en: Just to confirm, engine-specific behavior, right? MySQL online DDL has different limits.
lines.zh: 确认一下，这是数据库特定行为，对吧？MySQL在线DDL限制不同。

lines.en: Exactly, including metadata locks and algorithms. Don't copy this approval across databases.
lines.zh: 对，包括元数据锁和算法选择，别把本次批准照搬到其他数据库。

lines.en: The statement runs outside transaction blocks. We'll configure bounded waits through reviewed settings.
lines.zh: 语句在事务块外执行，用评审过的设置限制等待。

lines.en: Define a rollback trigger before execution. Cancellation may leave an unusable index.
lines.zh: 执行前定义回退触发条件，取消可能留下不可用索引。

lines.en: Okay, simultaneous schema changes? Let's park that. Maybe they compete for table locks.
lines.zh: 好，同时做其他结构变更先放一边，它们可能争抢表锁。

lines.en: Our working hypothesis isn't zero impact. We expect tolerable waits with monitoring.
lines.zh: 当前假设不是零影响，而是监控下可接受的等待。

lines.en: So, I'll correct the change description. It must state that risk clearly.
lines.zh: 那我修改变更描述，必须明确写出这个风险。

dialogues.title: 低峰也要有停止条件
dialogues.premise: 锁风险和执行模式明确，安排低峰窗口及值守。
dialogues.listeningTask: 辨别低峰降低风险而非消除风险。

lines.en: Use the off-peak window at midnight. This maintenance window has staffed coverage.
lines.zh: 使用午夜低峰窗口，这个维护窗口有人值守。

lines.en: Is the batch scheduler quiet then? Low request traffic doesn't guarantee low writes.
lines.zh: 批处理调度那时安静吗？请求少不保证写入少。

lines.en: The reporting batch will finish beforehand. We'll check actual workload before starting.
lines.zh: 报表批处理会提前结束，开始前仍检查实际负载。

lines.en: Just to confirm, no automatic start, right? Maybe the batch runs late tonight.
lines.zh: 确认一下，不自动开始，对吧？今晚批处理可能延迟。

lines.en: Correct. Preflight failure means postponement instead. Nobody needs to force this through.
lines.zh: 对，预检失败就延期，没必要硬做。

lines.en: Okay, what's the ETA from rehearsal? Include waiting and validation, not just scanning.
lines.zh: 好，预演估计多久？包括等待和验证，不只是扫描。

lines.en: Roughly twenty minutes with spare margin. Production volume can make it longer.
lines.zh: 大约二十分钟，另留余量，生产数据量可能让它更久。

lines.en: The rollback trigger includes sustained write delays. A growing lock wait also means stop.
lines.zh: 回退触发条件包括持续写延迟，锁等待增长也应停止。

lines.en: Record thresholds in the approved ticket. Watch replica lag and free storage.
lines.zh: 阈值写进批准工单，也观察副本延迟和空闲存储。

lines.en: So, I'll cover customer-facing metrics tonight. The query switch stays off initially.
lines.zh: 那今晚我盯客户指标，查询开关最初保持关闭。

dialogues.title: 先等旧事务结束
dialogues.premise: 午夜窗口到达，检查旧事务、磁盘余量和并发结构变更。
dialogues.listeningTask: 听出预检暂停原因和不直接杀事务的选择。

lines.en: A long-running transaction remains on October. It belongs to the reporting job.
lines.zh: 十月分区仍有一个长事务，属于报表任务。

lines.en: Then preflight isn't clear just yet. Ask its owner before any cancellation.
lines.zh: 那预检还没通过，取消前必须问负责人。

lines.en: Okay, pause our go/no-go decision here. The off-peak window isn't permission itself.
lines.zh: 好，先暂停继续与否的决策，低峰窗口本身不是执行许可。

lines.en: I'm on it with that owner. About three minutes remain, they estimate.
lines.zh: 我联系负责人，他们估计还要三分钟左右。

lines.en: Don't kill it just for convenience. A lock wait could outlast expectations.
lines.zh: 别只为省事杀掉事务，锁等待也可能比预计长。

lines.en: Storage covers index and temporary build space. No other schema changes are scheduled.
lines.zh: 存储余量覆盖索引和构建临时空间，没有其他结构变更安排。

lines.en: Verify privileges and exact leaf table. Also confirm we're outside a transaction block.
lines.zh: 验证权限和准确叶表，也确认不是在事务块中。

lines.en: Just to confirm, wait for completion, right? Then rerun the transaction age check.
lines.zh: 确认一下，等它完成，对吧？之后再检查事务年龄。

lines.en: The owner now reports successful completion. Database activity confirms no old transaction.
lines.zh: 负责人现在报告完成成功，数据库活动也确认没有旧事务。

lines.en: So, the repeated preflight checks pass. I'll start only the approved partition.
lines.zh: 那重新预检通过，我只开始批准的分区。

dialogues.title: 构建进度不是可用状态
dialogues.premise: 预检通过，在单个叶分区开始并发构建。
dialogues.listeningTask: 区分扫描进度、验证阶段和索引真正可用。

lines.en: Build progress shows the first scan. The concurrent index build has started.
lines.zh: 构建进度显示首次扫描，并发索引构建已开始。

lines.en: Keep watching activity during later phases. It may wait before final validation.
lines.zh: 后续阶段也观察活动，最终验证前可能等待。

lines.en: Writes continue within the approved budget. Search traffic still uses its old path.
lines.zh: 写入仍在批准预算内，检索流量仍用原路径。

lines.en: Just to confirm, not usable yet, right? Don't announce success from scan progress.
lines.zh: 确认一下，现在还不可用，对吧？别凭扫描进度宣布成功。

lines.en: Exactly. I'll keep an eye on errors. We need completion and catalog checks.
lines.zh: 对，我观察错误，需要完成状态和系统目录检查。

lines.en: No long-running transaction appears so far. Current lock waits remain below our threshold.
lines.zh: 目前没出现长事务，当前锁等待低于阈值。

lines.en: Don't launch another build beside it. One successful start isn't capacity evidence.
lines.zh: 别旁边再开一个构建，启动成功不代表容量足够。

lines.en: Okay, what's the ETA from progress? Maybe give a range until validation.
lines.zh: 好，按进度预计多久？验证结束前给个范围吧。

lines.en: About ten to twenty minutes remaining. Waiting phases make that estimate uncertain.
lines.zh: 大约还要十到二十分钟，等待阶段让估计不确定。

lines.en: So, I'll keep support informed internally. No query switch until checks pass.
lines.zh: 那我给内部支持团队更新，检查通过前不切查询开关。

dialogues.title: 延迟升高先停止扩大
dialogues.premise: 索引扫描推进，副本回放延迟短暂上升，需要按阈值决策。
dialogues.listeningTask: 分清停止扩展和取消当前构建的不同触发条件。

lines.en: WAL generation rose during the build. Replica lag reached roughly twelve seconds.
lines.zh: 构建期间WAL生成增加，副本延迟达到大约十二秒。

lines.en: Is it sustained or falling already? Our abort threshold needs sustained pressure.
lines.zh: 持续还是已经下降？中止阈值要求持续压力。

lines.en: It's falling across the latest samples. Customer writes still meet their target.
lines.zh: 最新几次采样在下降，客户写入仍满足目标。

lines.en: Just to confirm, expansion stays paused, right? Another partition could multiply this load.
lines.zh: 确认一下，不扩大，对吧？再加分区可能倍增负载。

lines.en: Correct. The rollback trigger isn't met. Continue this build with close observation.
lines.zh: 对，尚未触发回退，密切观察下继续当前构建。

lines.en: Build progress entered the validation phase. Disk space remains above the reserve.
lines.zh: 构建进度进入验证阶段，磁盘空间仍高于预留线。

lines.en: I'll keep an eye on replay. Byte backlog matters beside the timer.
lines.zh: 我观察回放，除了延迟计时也看字节积压。

lines.en: Okay, faster rollout? Let's park that. Maybe later batches need separate windows.
lines.zh: 好，加快扩展先放一边，后续批次可能需要独立窗口。

lines.en: If write latency breaches, cancel carefully. Then inspect any remaining catalog entry.
lines.zh: 写延迟超阈值就谨慎取消，再检查系统目录残留。

lines.en: So, no additional changes tonight then. We'll decide completion from all checks.
lines.zh: 那今晚不加其他变更，结合所有检查判断是否完成。

dialogues.title: 有效、正确、收益三个检查
dialogues.premise: 构建命令成功返回，副本延迟恢复，需要目录和业务验收。
dialogues.listeningTask: 听出索引有效不等于所有查询都应使用它。

lines.en: Index validity is confirmed in catalog. The build returned success without errors.
lines.zh: 系统目录确认索引有效，构建成功返回且无错误。

lines.en: Verify the exact columns and predicate. A valid wrong index still disappoints.
lines.zh: 核验准确列和条件，有效但建错的索引仍没用。

lines.en: They match our approved non-unique definition. The query plan improves selective searches.
lines.zh: 匹配批准的非唯一定义，执行计划改善了选择性高的查询。

lines.en: Just to confirm, broad scans allowed, right? Don't force every query through it.
lines.zh: 确认一下，宽范围扫描仍允许，对吧？别强迫所有查询都用它。

lines.en: Yes, the smoke test passed correctness. Pagination and tenant boundaries still match.
lines.zh: 是，冒烟测试通过正确性验证，分页和租户边界仍一致。

lines.en: WAL generation has returned near normal. We're back to baseline for replica lag.
lines.zh: WAL生成接近正常，副本延迟回到基线。

lines.en: Now enable the query switch gradually. Measure writes alongside each read batch.
lines.zh: 现在逐步启用查询开关，每批读流量都同时测写入。

lines.en: Okay, about five minutes per step. Maybe cache warmth affects the first samples.
lines.zh: 好，每步大约五分钟，缓存预热可能影响最初样本。

lines.en: Compare equivalent workloads, not mixed averages. Cold and warm tests need labels.
lines.zh: 对比等价负载，不混用平均值，冷暖缓存测试要标清。

lines.en: So, I'll record both result sets. The canary's search responses remain correct.
lines.zh: 那我记录两组结果，灰度检索响应仍正确。

dialogues.title: 回退查询与删除索引分开
dialogues.premise: 查询开关灰度通过，回顾未来回退及失败构建残留处理。
dialogues.listeningTask: 区分功能回退、取消构建和独立删除流程。

lines.en: What if an invalid index remains? Cancellation doesn't always remove its entry.
lines.zh: 如果留下无效索引呢？取消不一定删除目录项。

lines.en: We inspect index validity after failure. Then review cleanup as separate work.
lines.zh: 失败后检查索引有效性，再单独评审清理工作。

lines.en: No invalid index exists tonight though. Our completed index passed all checks.
lines.zh: 不过今晚没有无效索引，已完成索引通过所有检查。

lines.en: Just to confirm, switch rollback first, right? That's the quickest temporary workaround.
lines.zh: 确认一下，先回退查询开关，对吧？这是最快的临时缓解。

lines.en: Yes, but it doesn't remove maintenance costs. Dropping needs its own reviewed procedure.
lines.zh: 对，但那不会消除维护成本，删除要有单独评审流程。

lines.en: For this leaf, concurrent drop is supported. Outside transaction blocks, with dependencies checked.
lines.zh: 这个叶表支持并发删除索引，在事务块外执行并检查依赖。

lines.en: Don't generalize that to parent indexes. Engine and object restrictions still apply.
lines.zh: 别类推到父表索引，数据库和对象限制仍适用。

lines.en: Okay, let's keep it under observation. Maybe write costs emerge with tomorrow's peak.
lines.zh: 好，继续观察，写成本可能在明天高峰显现。

lines.en: The rollback trigger covers peak write delays. Removal requires approval, not automatic deletion.
lines.zh: 回退触发条件覆盖高峰写延迟，删除要批准，不是自动删除。

lines.en: So, I'll keep both paths documented. Query rollback and index removal stay separate.
lines.zh: 那我记录两条路径，查询回退与索引删除保持分离。

dialogues.title: 收益成立，扩展仍需批准
dialogues.premise: 首个叶分区完成验收，下一工作日峰值观察通过，总结后续任务。
dialogues.listeningTask: 听出首批成功不是全分区批准。

lines.en: Write overhead stayed within our budget. Peak observation passed on October's partition.
lines.zh: 额外写成本仍在预算内，十月分区高峰观察通过。

lines.en: Read improvements matched the rehearsal results. Broad searches still use sensible scans.
lines.zh: 读收益符合预演结果，宽范围检索仍合理使用扫描。

lines.en: The query plan evidence is attached. We didn't trade correctness for speed.
lines.zh: 执行计划证据已附，没有为速度牺牲正确性。

lines.en: So, who's picking this up next? Raj reviews other partitions separately, right?
lines.zh: 那下一步谁接？Raj单独评审其他分区，对吧？

lines.en: Yes, not an automatic wider rollout. Each partition has different size and traffic.
lines.zh: 是，不自动扩大，每个分区大小和流量不同。

lines.en: My action item is sizing by Friday. Maybe older partitions don't need this index.
lines.zh: 我的行动项是周五前估算，也许旧分区不需要这个索引。

lines.en: I'll add cancellation cleanup to rehearsal. Concurrent index build failures need practice too.
lines.zh: 我把取消清理加入预演，并发构建失败也需要练习。

lines.en: Okay, update the runbook this week. Keep database-specific lock limits clearly stated.
lines.zh: 好，本周更新运行手册，把数据库特定锁限制写清。

lines.en: I'll review that and removal dependencies. No universal online-means-lock-free statement should remain.
lines.zh: 我评审手册和删除依赖，不能留下在线等于无锁的通用说法。

lines.en: We'll close the loop next review. Bring read gains and write costs together.
lines.zh: 下次评审闭环，一起展示读收益和写成本。
